notes.title: 1.43 Patch Released
notes.content:
Version 1.43 changelog

Fixes:
	Fixed stupid "Dropped Sync Frame" netcode bug
	Fixed some minor map setup problems
	Fixed lag from ricochet effects on complex ships
	Improved performance of tethers
	Fixed some incorrect Designer warnings
	
Gameplay:
	Reduced base collision damage by 12.5%
	Better Collision Damage tolerance for battleships
	Liquid Rocket engine now regenerates fuel, instead of limiting you to 3 burns
	Mastermind Servers can now set specific budget limits
	Started using the Metric system in one place

New Parts
	Pyrotechnic Bolt
	Contact Trigger
	Proximity Trigger
	Spinal Weapon Guidance
	
Designer Changes:
	Added "Undo" System
	Gimbal Memorizes your Mirror and Snap settings
	Software Parts have color coded icons
	Certain parts can now link with Software parts (chaining)
	Added coarse and fine Rotation (CTRL & SHIFT keys)
	
Server Management:
	Created the "GimbalServerBuddy", which watches gimbal servers and restarts them if they go down

notes.title: Ship of the Week - Banshee
notes.content:
[url=http://www.gimbalgame.com/sotw/Banshee.png][img]http://www.gimbalgame.com/sotw/banshee_steam_banner.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z3AV9ix_69c][Video][/url]
[url=http://www.gimbalgame.com/sotw/Banshee.png][Download Ship][/url]

The "Banshee" class corvette is an opportunistic killer that can roam a map, picking off the weak, and harassing the strong. In other words, a huge pain in the ass. The armor and speed make it very hard to crack, and the lasers are pinpoint accurate at any velocity. With a price of $41,000T, this ship is a bargain amongst Mastermind ships. The only drawback is a lack of maneuverability, so you'll just have to enjoy where this airframe takes you.

"Momentum" Design
Low Profile
7X Guided Heavy Lasers
Spinal Bison Launcher
Automatic Repulsors
1300 MPH Speed

Class: Mastermind
Author: Runac
